content: Hi! My son is failing Algebra II (58% right now, final's in 6 weeks) and his teacher says it's really old 8th grade gaps with fractions and equations. Can you get him started ASAP? I'm on a quick break before my shift so I need to move fast 😊

Hi there! I’m Dana, happy to help. We can get your son started within 3 days and match a tutor to his current Algebra II unit while filling those fraction and equation gaps.  

Do you have a preferred day and time window (e.g., weekday evenings or Saturday mornings) for his weekly 50‑minute sessions?
Sounds great, I'm basically ready to sign up for Larkspur Algebra Coaching today! Anything I should know first, or how do we get started?

Great! I’m Dana—here’s a quick rundown so you can enroll right away:

**Plans**  
- **Standard:** 4 × 50‑min sessions/month – $96 / mo (first month $72 if you enroll by Sun 22 Nov).  
- **Intensive:** 8 × 50‑min sessions/month – $176 / mo.

Both include a consistent tutor, session summaries for you, and flexible rescheduling with ≥ 24‑hr notice. Sessions run Mon‑Fri 4‑10 pm ET or Sat 9 am‑5 pm ET; the first session can be booked within 3 days of signup.

**How to enroll** – just visit [larkspurtutors.example/enroll](https://larkspurtutors.example/enroll) and choose the plan that fits your schedule. No registration fee, and you can cancel any time from the account page.

If you run into any issues, email help@larkspurtutors.example. Let me know if you’d like the Standard or Intensive plan, and I’ll note your preferred time slot so the tutor can be ready!

Okay, so Standard is $96 a month and Intensive is $176? That's way more than I budgeted, I was hoping for around $60 all in. Is there anything closer to that? And if I sign up today, can I cancel after one month if it isn't helping, or am I locked in?

I understand budgeting is important. Our only current discount is the **Standard plan’s first month for $72** (a 25 % off promotion) if you enroll by Sun 22 Nov; after that it’s $96 / month. We don’t have a $60 option at this time.

You’re not locked in: plans bill monthly in advance, renew automatically, and you can cancel any time from your account page. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing month with no fee. If you change your mind within 7 days of signing up and have used only one session, we’ll refund the entire first‑month payment.

If the Standard plan works for you, you can enroll now at the promotional rate and start within 3 days. Let me know if you’d like to proceed!

Okay, $72 first month then $96 after is still more than I wanted, and I'm not sure about auto-renewing. Does the 7-day refund only apply if he's had one session, and does the 'end of billing month' cancel mean I pay for the whole next month? Also, can you show me something in writing about the refund before I enroll?

Sure—here are the key points in plain language:

**Refund & Cancellation**  
- **7‑day refund:** If you request a full refund within 7 days of signup *and* only one session (or none) has been used, we’ll return the entire first‑month payment.  
- **Cancel anytime:** You can cancel from your account page at any time. Your cancellation takes effect at the **end of the current billing month**, so you won’t be charged for the next month. You’ll keep the sessions you’ve already taken in that month.  

**Auto‑renew** is simply the monthly billing cycle; you’re free to stop it before the next charge by canceling as described above.

You can view the full terms here: https://larkspurtutors.example/terms‑and‑conditions  

If you’re ready, you can enroll now at the promotional $72 first month and schedule the first session within 3 days. Let me know if you’d like the link again or have any other questions!

Okay, but I still don't see anything under $72 to start, and $96 a month is well over what I budgeted. Also, the agent said cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing month, so if I cancel mid-month do I still get charged the full $96 for that month? And I'd like to see the terms page before I decide, because I got burned on a gym contract last year. I'll look at this on my break and get back to you.
